title: oddkin.table-columns
description: Columns of a table, in order: the cell each shows, its header, and its sorting.
$comment: Also enforced by validate(), not expressible here: uniqueIds(key).

key.description: Names the cell of each row that the column shows.

label.description: Header text, which also names the column.

sortable.description: The header sorts the rows by this column.
